what_to_detect: A permanent with modular enters the battlefield with modular's number of +1/+1 counters.
near_miss: A permanent with modular entering without its counters, for instance because counters cannot be put on it.
record_fields: resolution payload events counter_change (counter_type, delta) on the entering permanent
zone_change to battlefield in the same effect half
the keyword's sidecar line (Keyword API type, keyword plus replacement keys)

what_to_detect: A permanent with several instances of modular enters with the counters of every instance added together.
near_miss: A permanent with one instance of modular entering with only that instance's counters.
record_fields: resolution payload events counter_change (counter_type, delta) on the entering permanent
zone_change to battlefield in the same effect half
the keyword's sidecar line (Keyword API type, keyword plus replacement keys)
card lines of kind keyword, granted (gen-3)
